description: Yandex Cloud placement settings of a tenant provider profile (no secrets).

fields.description: Yandex Cloud cloud id owning the folder.
fields.name: cloud_id
fields.title: Cloud id

fields.description: Folder every VM, disk and network of a run is created in.
fields.name: folder_id
fields.title: Folder id

fields.description: Availability zone of ru-central1 the run is placed in.
fields.name: zone
fields.title: Zone

fields.description: Three physical zones for multi-zone topologies. When omitted, use zone and two other catalog zones. Single-zone topologies use zone.
fields.name: zones
fields.title: Distributed topology zones

fields.description: Create one network for the profile, or place runs into an existing one. Every run gets its own subnets and security group in it.
fields.name: network

fields.description: IPv4 range the run subnets are allocated from, one block per zone sized to its machines.
fields.name: pool_cidr
fields.title: Address pool

fields.description: Retired: run subnets come from pool_cidr; a stored value is ignored.
fields.name: subnet_cidr
fields.title: Subnet CIDR

fields.description: Existing VPC network the run subnets are created in.
fields.name: network_id
fields.title: Network id

fields.description: IPv4 range of the network kept free for runs; run subnets are allocated from it and must not overlap other subnets of the network.
fields.name: pool_cidr
fields.title: Address pool

fields.description: Route table with a route out (e.g. 0.0.0.0/0 through a NAT gateway) for machines without public addresses. When empty, such a run creates its own NAT gateway.
fields.name: route_table_id
fields.title: Route table id
Network

fields.description: Assign a one-to-one NAT public address to every machine. Without them a created network gets one shared NAT gateway for the profile.
fields.name: public_ips
fields.title: Public IPs

fields.description: Boot image family from the standard-images folder.
fields.name: image_family
fields.title: Image family

fields.description: Use preemptible VMs: much cheaper, but stopped after 24h or under pressure — do not use for a measurement that must complete.
fields.name: preemptible
fields.title: Preemptible
